values.note: Double sites (14D, 15D) $40 a night. $3 per vehicle day-use fee; showers $2 for non-campers.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/hurricane-campground ('Single Site: $20 per night', 'Double Site: $40 per night', '$3 per vehicle day use fee. $2 per shower (non-camper).') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233308/rates (2026 Peak Season May 1-Oct 31 STANDARD NONELECTRIC $20), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Sites 1, 6, 9, 11, 14D, 19 and 22 are reservable on recreation.gov; the rest are first-come, paid at the fee station (cash/check) or by Scan & Pay in the recreation.gov app. The 2026 rate table runs a first-come walk-in season April 17-30 before the reservable peak season May 1-October 31. 14 nights in any 30. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon; gate open 7 am-10 pm.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/hurricane-campground ('We currently accept reservations for or sites #1,6,9,11,14D,19 and 22'; 'you may use Scan & Pay ... to pay for a first come-first served campsite'; 'You may stay up to 14 nights total at this campground within rolling 30 days'; 'Gate open 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233308 (rules maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days'; notice 'Check-in is at 2pm and check-out is at 12pm') + /rates ('First-come, First-served Season 2026-04-17 2026-04-30', 'Peak Season 2026-05-01 2026-10-31'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/hurricane-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Mid-April through late October.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 18 standard non-electric sites (16 take RVs/trailers, two pull-through) and 4 tent-only sites, plus host/management sites. The catalog lists driveways up to 50-65 ft, but recreation.gov warns 'Due to turn ratios the access road is not recommended for RVs longer than 30 feet or towed vehicles.'

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233308 (site types, equipment, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233308 (notice 'Due to turn ratios the access road is not recommended for RVs longer than 30 feet or towed vehicles'; 'Large RVs are not recommended'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233308 (every family site typed STANDARD NONELECTRIC or TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC; only host sites have hookups per https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/hurricane-campground 'Hosts are provided a site with water, sewer, and electricity'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233308 ('Hurricane has drinking water, flush toilets, hot showers and a playing field.'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on the Forest Service page and recreation.gov: $20 single / $40 double, 0 electric, reservable (7 named sites) with the rest first-come, 14 nights in 30, mid-April to late October, drinking water/flush toilets/showers, 22 family sites, access road not recommended over 30 ft. Not stated: sewer/water at sites, dump station. Note left as is (AWH 'Reservable during peak season' agrees with the rate table).
